series_end_reason: From the Q1 2026 release (0001654954-26-004051) GSK's HIV turnover table lists Dolutegravir products (Dovato, Juluca, Tivicay, Triumeq), Long Acting Injectables (Apretude, Cabenuva) and 'Other' (GBP 41m in Q1 2026) with no Rukobia row; the Q2 2026 release (0001654954-26-006949) has the same structure. Rukobia is therefore folded into HIV 'Other' and no per-product figure is printed for 2026Q1-2026Q2.
indication_area: HIV (heavily treatment-experienced adults with multidrug-resistant HIV-1)
moa: HIV-1 gp120-directed attachment inhibitor (prodrug of temsavir)

approval_evidence.quote: 07/02/2020 ORIG-1 Approval Type 1 - New Molecular Entity PRIORITY (NDA 212950, RUKOBIA FOSTEMSAVIR TROMETHAMINE)

notes: Worldwide Group turnover (ViiV Healthcare, consolidated in GSK). First row is Q3 2020 (GBP 3m), the quarter after FDA approval on 2 July 2020; no cited GSK document states the launch quarter, so launch_quarter is null. The Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 releases still list Rukobia in the products appendix (fostemsavir, Specialty medicines, HIV/AIDS) but print no sales for it.
search_log: Bigdata.com smart search ('GSK Benlysta turnover third quarter 2021', filings) returned no chunks for GSK Q3 2021; document discovery therefore done directly on EDGAR.
listed GSK (CIK 0001131399) filings via data.sec.gov submissions incl. paginated older files, all form types (6-K, 6-K/A, 20-F counted); 6,839 filings listed

2012-2026: selected 6-Ks whose primaryDocDescription matches 1ST/2ND/3RD QUARTER RESULTS, HALF-YEAR(LY) REPORT, FINAL RESULTS (the 2022-02-07 'PUBLICATION OF FULL YEAR 2021 RESULTS' 6-K was skipped in favour of the 2022-02-09 FINAL RESULTS 6-K); 2008-2011: results 6-Ks identified by hand from filings in the late-Jan/Feb, late-Apr, late-Jul and late-Oct windows (descriptions are generic 'FORM 6-K'/'6-K'); 2010-09-10 'historical quarterly turnover by product' 6-K not used as a source, each quarter is read from its own results announcement

fetched each main document from sec.gov Archives and parsed table rows; the product's regional turnover rows (Total, growth %, US, Europe, International where printed) were taken: Q1 release first such row; Q2/Q3 releases first row = quarter, second = year-to-date; Q4 release first row = full year, second row = fourth quarter
arithmetic check run on every year: Q1+Q2 = printed six-month row, +Q3 = printed nine-month row, +Q4 = printed full-year row; no mismatch beyond rounding found
Rukobia rows found in every results release Q3 2020-Q4 2025 (22 quarters); absent from the turnover tables of the Q1 and Q2 2026 releases
